claim: Client needs help manually entering invoice data from PDFs into QuickBooks daily
paraphrased_evidence: A small business owner posted a job seeking a virtual assistant to manually type invoice details from scanned PDFs into QuickBooks. They mentioned spending 2-3 hours per day on this task and experiencing frequent typos that cause payment errors.

claim: Client wants to automate weekly lead transfer from Salesforce to Mailchimp to replace manual CSV export/import
paraphrased_evidence: A marketing manager posted a job requesting help building an integration between Salesforce and Mailchimp. They described the current process as exporting a CSV from Salesforce, cleaning columns in Excel, and importing into Mailchimp every Monday, which takes 4-5 hours and often results in duplicate or missing contacts.

claim: Client needs help consolidating 12 regional Excel sales files into one master report each month
paraphrased_evidence: A financial analyst posted a job for a freelancer to automate the monthly consolidation of sales data from 12 regional Excel files into a single master workbook. They noted the manual copy-paste process takes two full days and frequently introduces errors that require rework.

claim: Client needs monthly bank reconciliation help because manual process is time-consuming and error-prone
paraphrased_evidence: A bookkeeper posted a job seeking help with monthly bank reconciliation. They described printing bank statements and manually checking each transaction against QuickBooks entries, taking 6-8 hours per month. They mentioned that missed discrepancies have caused overdraft fees and incorrect tax filings.

claim: Client wants to automate daily task updates from Trello to Asana to eliminate manual transfer
paraphrased_evidence: A project coordinator posted a job for a freelancer to build a sync between Trello and Asana. They explained that each morning they manually read Trello cards and update corresponding Asana tasks, which takes 1-2 hours and causes delays in cross-team visibility.
